title: Calculation chain of equalities then inequalities for CoRN's first refinement lemma
intent: Bound the difference between the Riemann sum of a partition P and that of its refinement Q by e*(b-a), where e is the modulus-of-continuity parameter. The proof chains four equality rewrites (ref_calc2..ref_calc5) that normalise the difference into one double sum of (fP_i - fQ_j) * (Q_j - Q_{j-1}), then three inequalities (ref_calc6..ref_calc8) up to e times that telescoping sum, and finally ref_calc1 collapses the inner sum to P_i - P_{i-1}.

parent.statement: Lemma first_refinement_lemma : AbsIR (Partition_Sum HfP incF[-]Partition_Sum HfQ incF) [<=] e[*] (b[-]a).

children.name: ref_calc1
children.statement:
Lemma ref_calc1 :
  forall (i : nat) (Hi : i < n),
  Sum2
    (fun (j : nat) (Hj : sub i <= j) (Hj' : j <= pred (sub (S i))) =>
     Q _ (H' _ _ Hi Hj') [-]Q _ (Nat.lt_le_incl _ _ (H _ _ Hi Hj'))) [=]
  P _ Hi[-]P _ (Nat.lt_le_incl _ _ Hi).

Lemma ref_calc2 :
  AbsIR (Partition_Sum HfP incF[-]Partition_Sum HfQ incF) [=]
  AbsIR
    (Sumx
       (fun (i : nat) (Hi : i < n) =>
        Part F (fP i Hi) just1[*]
        Sum2
          (fun (j : nat) (Hj : sub i <= j) (Hj' : j <= pred (sub (S i))) =>
           Q _ (H' _ _ Hi Hj') [-]Q _ (Nat.lt_le_incl _ _ (H _ _ Hi Hj')))) [-]
     Sumx
       (fun (i : nat) (Hi : i < n) =>
        Sum2
          (fun (j : nat) (Hj : sub i <= j) (Hj' : j <= pred (sub (S i))) =>
           Part F (fQ j (H _ _ Hi Hj')) just2[*]
           (Q _ (H' _ _ Hi Hj') [-]Q _ (Nat.lt_le_incl _ _ (H _ _ Hi Hj')))))).

applicability.goal_shape: A bound |S(f,P) - S(f,Q)| <= e*(b-a) between two Riemann sums where Q refines P, stated as an AbsIR(._-_.) [<=] e[*](b[-]a) goal over constructive reals (CoRN IR), to be reached by equality rewrites of the left side followed by triangle inequalities and a modulus-of-continuity bound.
applicability.use_when: the two sides differ by a sequence of algebraic normalisations (pull sums apart, commute scalars, factor a common difference) followed by triangle inequalities and a continuity bound; each step is worth naming as its own lemma so the chain cites a flat list of statements.
applicability.avoid_when: the intermediate terms are not worth naming (inline the rewrites instead); the steps need different hypotheses at different points (here only ref_calc8 uses the modulus of continuity, the rest are purely algebraic); a single long rewrite would be fragile to term-index mismatches.

consequences: Each link is either an equality applied with leEq_wdl (rewriting the left side of the inequality down, ref_calc2..ref_calc5) or an inequality applied with leEq_transitive (ref_calc6..ref_calc8), so the chain is only as strong as its weakest link and a single mismatched rewrite breaks every link after it. The head of the chain must end in a form the tail can discharge: here ref_calc8 leaves e times an inner sum, the tail factors out e, ref_calc1 telescopes the inner sum to P_i - P_{i-1}, and the library lemma Mengolli_Sum telescopes the outer sum to b - a. The modulus of continuity enters only at ref_calc8, so the first seven links are purely algebraic and reusable for other integrands.
